content.text: Low-Sb compositions are the only ones with any photoactivity so far: 0.075% EQE at Sb 0.19. I'm checking XRD on the 0.23–0.31 Sb range to choose where to spend my last EQE measurement.

input.rationale: Out of 5 EQE measurements, Sb 0.19 (index 3) gave the highest EQE, 0.075%. EQE rises from Sb 0.12 (0.053%) to 0.19, then falls at 0.25 (0.046%). It is about zero at 0.49 and 0.75. XRD patterns at Sb 0.19, 0.25 and 0.31 are almost the same: the strongest peak is at Q≈1.88, which looks like a rutile-type FeSbO4 phase with extra Fe. So the change in EQE probably comes from composition and defects, not from a phase change. The peak EQE is near Sb≈0.19.

rejected.reason: Near-stoichiometric FeSbO4 gave about zero EQE (-0.0005%)
Sb-rich film gave about zero EQE (-0.004%)

content.text:
I submitted index 3 (Sb fraction 0.19) as the best composition. At 0.075% EQE it was the highest of the five compositions I measured. I used all 5 EQE measurements and 3 of the 5 XRD scans.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0.12 | 0.053 |
| **3** | **0.19** | **0.075** |
| 6 | 0.25 | 0.046 |
| 14 | 0.49 | about 0 (−0.0005) |
| 24 | 0.75 | about 0 (−0.004) |

- **Where the peak is:** EQE rises from Sb 0.12 to 0.19 and then drops by 0.25. So the best point is probably near 0.19, but it could sit anywhere between 0.12 and 0.25. I didn't measure the untested points in that range (indices 1, 2, 4 and 5), so a slightly better composition may be there.
- **Higher-Sb films:** the compositions at Sb 0.49 and 0.75 gave essentially no photoresponse under 2.4 eV light at pH 3.
- **Structure:** the XRD patterns at Sb 0.19, 0.25 and 0.31 are nearly identical. My reading is that they match a rutile-type FeSbO4 phase with extra Fe, not hematite. I didn't confirm this against simulated patterns. If it holds, the EQE change across this range comes from composition, not a change of phase.

All the EQE values are small (below 0.1%), so this line looks like a weak photoanode overall under these conditions.
